about: What the judge answers about a text a probe returned. The data stage (`texts`): each text as the probe returns it, by its own entry, or the fixture's default; none of the fixture's texts holds an instruction, so every one gets the default. The probe's own title check, asked through the core before a title is served (`titles`): each title as the probe sends it (redacted), by its own entry, or `title_default`. The poisoned repository's two pull request titles with instructions are flagged at both.
